info.name: Loanova API
info.description:
Dokumentasi lengkap REST API untuk aplikasi backend Loanova.

Base URL: http://localhost:9091

Semua response menggunakan format standar ApiResponse.

request.description:
POST /api/auth/register

Mendaftarkan customer baru. Public endpoint.

Fields:
- username (String, required)
- email (String, required)
- password (String, required, harus strong password)

POST /api/auth/login

Login user (semua role). Token otomatis tersimpan ke collection variables.

Fields:
- username (String, required)
- password (String, required)
- fcmToken (String, optional - untuk push notification)

POST /api/auth/firebase-google

Login menggunakan Google via Firebase Authentication.

Fields:
- idToken (String, required - Firebase ID Token)
- fcmToken (String, optional - untuk push notification)

POST /api/auth/refresh

Refresh access token menggunakan refresh token.

Fields:
- refreshToken (String, required)

POST /api/auth/logout

Logout user dan invalidasi token.
Auth: AUTH:LOGOUT

Fields:
- refreshToken (String, required)

POST /api/auth/forgot-password

Request link reset password ke email. Public endpoint.

Fields:
- email (String, required, harus valid email)

POST /api/auth/reset-password

Reset password menggunakan token dari email. Public endpoint.

Fields:
- token (String, required)
- newPassword (String, required, harus strong password)

POST /api/auth/change-password

Mengganti password saat user sedang login.
Auth: AUTH:CHANGE_PASSWORD

Fields:
- currentPassword (String, required)
- newPassword (String, required, harus strong password)

GET /api/users

Mengambil daftar semua user.
Auth: USER:READ (Superadmin)

POST /api/users

Membuat user internal baru.
Auth: USER:CREATE (Superadmin)

Fields:
- username (String, required, max 50)
- email (String, required, valid email)
- password (String, required, strong password)
- branchId (Long, optional - boleh null untuk customer)
- isActive (Boolean, required)
- roleIds (Set<Long>, required, minimal 1)

PUT /api/users/{id}

Memperbarui data user (tanpa password).
Auth: USER:UPDATE (Superadmin)

Fields:
- username (String, required, max 50)
- email (String, required, valid email)
- branchId (Long, optional)
- isActive (Boolean, required)
- roleIds (Set<Long>, required, minimal 1)

GET /api/user-profiles/me

Mengambil profil user yang sedang login.
Auth: PROFILE:READ_MY (Customer)

POST /api/user-profiles/complete

Melengkapi data profil (Multipart/form-data).
Auth: PROFILE:COMPLETE (Customer)

Fields:
- fullName (String, required, max 100)
- phoneNumber (String, required, max 20)
- userAddress (String, required)
- nik (String, required, exactly 16 chars)
- birthDate (LocalDate, required, format: yyyy-MM-dd)
- npwpNumber (String, optional, max 16)
- ktpPhoto (File, required)
- profilePhoto (File, required)
- npwpPhoto (File, optional)

PUT /api/user-profiles/update

Memperbarui data profil (Multipart/form-data). Foto bersifat opsional saat update.
Auth: PROFILE:UPDATE (Customer)

Fields:
- fullName (String, required, max 100)
- phoneNumber (String, required, max 20)
- userAddress (String, required)
- nik (String, required, exactly 16 chars)
- birthDate (LocalDate, required, format: yyyy-MM-dd)
- npwpNumber (String, optional, max 16)
- ktpPhoto (File, optional)
- profilePhoto (File, optional)
- npwpPhoto (File, optional)

GET /api/roles

Daftar semua role.
Auth: ROLE:READ (Superadmin)

POST /api/roles

Membuat role custom baru.
Auth: ROLE:CREATE (Superadmin)

Fields:
- roleName (String, required, max 15)
- roleDescription (String, required, max 255)
- permissionIds (Set<Integer>, optional)

PUT /api/roles/{id}

Update role description & permissions.
Auth: ROLE:UPDATE (Superadmin)

Fields:
- roleDescription (String, required, max 255)
- permissionIds (Set<Integer>, optional)

GET /api/permissions

Daftar semua permission sistem.
Auth: PERMISSION:READ (Superadmin)

POST /api/user-plafonds/assign

Assign plafond ke user (Customer). Plafond lama yang masih aktif akan otomatis dinonaktifkan.
Auth: USER_PLAFOND:ASSIGN (Superadmin/Backoffice)

Fields:
- userId (Long, required)
- plafondId (Long, required)
- maxAmount (BigDecimal, required, harus > 0)

GET /api/user-plafonds/users/{userId}/active

Get plafond aktif user.
Auth: USER_PLAFOND:READ (Superadmin/Backoffice, atau Customer untuk diri sendiri)

GET /api/user-plafonds/users/{userId}/history

Get riwayat semua plafond user (active + inactive).
Auth: USER_PLAFOND:HISTORY

POST /api/loan-applications

Submit pengajuan pinjaman baru (Multipart/form-data).
Auth: LOAN:SUBMIT (Customer)

Fields:
- branchId (String, required)
- amount (String, required)
- tenor (String, required)
- occupation (String, required, max 50)
- companyName (String, optional, max 50)
- rekeningNumber (String, required, max 50)
- savingBookCover (File, required)
- payslipPhoto (File, required)
- latitude (String, required)
- longitude (String, required)

GET /api/loan-applications

Get semua pengajuan (Filter by role).
Superadmin/Backoffice: semua data
Marketing/BranchManager: data cabang sendiri
Customer: data sendiri
Auth: LOAN:READ_ALL

GET /api/loan-applications/my

Get pengajuan saya sendiri.
Auth: LOAN:READ_MY (Customer)

GET /api/loan-applications/{id}/history

Get history status pengajuan.
Auth: LOAN:HISTORY (All Roles)

GET /api/loan-applications/pending-review

Get list pending review (status PENDING_REVIEW).
Auth: LOAN:LIST_PENDING_REVIEW (Marketing)

PUT /api/loan-applications/{id}/review

Review pengajuan (PROCEED/REJECT).
Auth: LOAN:REVIEW (Marketing)

Fields:
- action (String, required - PROCEED atau REJECT)
- comment (String, optional - wajib jika REJECT)

GET /api/loan-applications/waiting-approval

Get list waiting approval (status WAITING_APPROVAL).
Auth: LOAN:LIST_WAITING_APPROVAL (Branch Manager)

PUT /api/loan-applications/{id}/approve

Approve/Reject pengajuan.
Auth: LOAN:APPROVE (Branch Manager)

Fields:
- action (String, required - APPROVE atau REJECT)
- comment (String, optional - wajib jika REJECT)

GET /api/loan-applications/waiting-disbursement

Get list waiting disbursement (status WAITING_DISBURSEMENT).
Auth: LOAN:LIST_WAITING_DISBURSE (Backoffice)

PUT /api/loan-applications/{id}/disburse

Cairkan dana pinjaman (status jadi DISBURSED).
Auth: LOAN:DISBURSE (Backoffice)

PUT /api/loan-applications/{id}/backoffice-reject

Tolak pencairan.
Auth: LOAN:REJECT_BACKOFFICE (Backoffice)

Fields:
- action (String, required - REJECT)
- comment (String, optional - alasan penolakan)

GET /api/plafonds/public

Daftar plafond untuk umum (landing page). Public endpoint.

GET /api/plafonds

Daftar semua plafond.
Auth: PLAFOND:READ (Superadmin)

POST /api/plafonds

Buat jenis plafond baru.
Auth: PLAFOND:CREATE (Superadmin)

Fields:
- name (String, required, max 100)
- description (String, required)
- maxAmount (BigDecimal, required, > 0)
- interestRate (BigDecimal, required, >= 0)
- tenorMin (Integer, required, >= 1 bulan)
- tenorMax (Integer, required, >= 1 bulan)

GET /api/branches

Daftar semua cabang.
Auth: BRANCH:READ (All Roles)

POST /api/branches

Tambah cabang baru.
Auth: BRANCH:CREATE (Superadmin)

Fields:
- branchCode (String, required, max 20)
- branchName (String, required, max 100)
- address (String, required)

PUT /api/branches/{id}

Update data cabang.
Auth: BRANCH:UPDATE (Superadmin)

Fields:
- branchCode (String, required, max 20)
- branchName (String, required, max 100)
- address (String, required)

PUT /api/branches/{id}/restore

Restore cabang yang dihapus.
Auth: BRANCH:RESTORE (Superadmin)

GET /api/notifications

Daftar notifikasi saya.
Auth: Authenticated

PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read

Tandai notifikasi sudah dibaca.
Auth: Authenticated

PUT /api/notifications/read-all

Tandai semua notifikasi sudah dibaca.
Auth: Authenticated

POST /api/notifications/test-push

Test kirim notifikasi.
Auth: ROLE_SUPERADMIN

Fields:
- username (String, required)
- title (String, required)
- message (String, required)

GET /api/dashboard/statistics

Statistik dashboard (role-based filtered).
Auth: DASHBOARD:STATISTICS

SUPERADMIN & BACKOFFICE: Semua data.
MARKETING & BRANCHMANAGER: Data cabang sendiri.
